title: callianthe elegans
intro: Callianthe elegans, commonly known as Passionflower, is a flowering plant native to the Americas. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anxiety and insomnia relief, as well as its potential to treat seizures and pain management. The therapeutic actions of Passionflower include its sedative and anxiolytic effects, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides. These constituents, particularly harman and harmine, may contribute to the plant's calming and analgesic properties.
